metadata.title: The Broken Milestone
metadata.description: Find nearby Trail Ruins and bring a brush and stone to restore the road marker.

tracker.complete_text: The old road marker has been found.

tracker.text: Carry 1 brush for the buried marker.
Bring 12 smooth stone for the repair.

offer.label: The Broken Milestone
lines: An old milestone is buried near the trail ruins, broken where the road forgot its own name.
Brush the marker clear and bring smooth stone so we can raise it again.
Reach the marked Trail Ruins and return with a brush and 12 smooth stone.
